items.headline: Jon Sumrall, Auburn top trolls from Week 7 in college football
items.description: After the upset, Sumrall was in a celebratory mood, donning a cowboy hat fit for a Texan while striding through the hallways of Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium.

items.headline: Ryder Burton rallies UAB to 30-17 come-from-behind victory over East Carolina in OT
items.description: — Ryder Burton threw a 6-yard touchdown pass to Rod Robinson II in overtime and Delvon Gulley followed with an 80-yard interception return to wrap up UAB’s come-from-behind 30-17 victory over East Carolina on Thursday night.

items.headline: Carter, Memphis pull away from UAB in the 3rd, win 38-13
items.description: — Jaylin Carter ran for 132 yards and two touchdowns, and Memphis beat UAB 38-13 on Saturday night.
